title: Premium Wine Tour with Cheese & Charcuterie Board
blurb:
Enjoy this private wine tasting tour of 4 of Niagara's world renowned wineries tasting the tantalizing vintages.

You'll be chauffeured from your hotel or air BnB to picturesque Niagara-on-the-Lake. You'll enjoy a tasty Cheese & Charcuterie Picnic Board at Between the Lines Winery as you sample your flight of wines, then you'll experience Peller Estate's frigid 10' Ice Lounge tour which will take you from vine to cellar. 

Half way through you'll visit the Olde Town district of Niagara on the Lake where you can enjoy some lunch or browse the shops, maybe even stroll down to the lake.

Next you're on your way to Wayne Gretzky's to choose 4 options from their exquisite wine and whisky portfolio. We'll wine-d up the tour with a visit to The Hare Wine Company. You can create your own custom flight of four wines from their selection of complex table wines and iconic icewines.

Reservations tend to fill quickly. Substitutions include Colaneri Estates & Chateau des Charmes.
